name: Moyasar
author: Moyasar Development Team

sections.description:
Payments with Ease

A comprehensive set of payment solutions that allows you to easily accept and track your transactions.

Accept e-Payments in your WooCommerce store using Moyasar’s plugin.

Features

  • Credit Card (Visa, MasterCard, Mada and American Express)
  • Apple Pay
  • STC Pay

This plugin support both Classic and Blocks:

  • Blocks: Developed using React JS.
  • Classic: Implemented natively.

Third-Party Services

This plugin relies on the following third-party services:

  1. Moyasar Payment Gateway
    Moyasar API is used for processing payments and communicating transaction data.

  2. Apple Pay
    The Apple Pay SDK is loaded from Apple’s CDN to enable Apple Pay functionality in supported browsers.

By using this plugin, you agree to the terms and conditions of these third-party services.

F. A. Q.

For more information, please visit: our website https://moyasar.com
sections.changelog:
v7.1.13

  • Fixed: Prevented multiple requests from being sent to fetch new order details in the Order class.
  • Improved: Added direct redirection when 3D Secure (3DS) is not required.
  • Disabled: The data-cfasync method.

v7.1.12

  • Fix: Removed the unregisterForm method from the moyasarApplePayClassic class to resolve issues affecting Credit Card functionality.

v7.1.11

  • Added support for data-cfasync="false" attribute on script tags to ensure compatibility with Cloudflare Rocket Loader.

v7.1.10

  • General Fixes

v7.1.9

  • Fix Coupon Codes Conflicts

v7.1.8

  • Fix STC Pay issue (i18n)

v7.1.7

  • Fix update order twice

v7.1.6

  • Enable DevTool in Webpack
  • Add more comments to the code

v7.1.5

  • Improvements

v7.1.4

  • Fix conflicts with another plugins

v7.1.3

  • General WP Fixes

v7.1.2

  • Fixed JS issues.

v7.1.1

  • Fixed JS issues.
  • Fixed Refund issue.

v7.1.0

  • Changes include:
  • Implemented popup modal for 3D secure (Classic).
  • Fixed an issue with creating the webhook secret key.
  • Fixed a card name placeholder.
  • Fixed conflicts with other plugins.
  • Fixed apple pay issues (Popup).

v7.0.0

  • Changes include:
  • Built-in Payment Forms: Implemented for Credit Card, Apple Pay, and STC Pay.

Support for Both Classic and Blocks:

  • Blocks: Developed using React JS.
  • Classic: Implemented natively.
